thesis_triggers.event: Reviewed 2026-11-04, unchanged at $185: Q3 confirmed growth (+55.5%) and margins (84.3%); $185 is well below our downside (P10) case. Net debt is now 342.4 (9-30) and the buyback authorization $3.6B after October's $3.2B raise (src 46, 47). At about $185 the stock trades at about 9.4x FY27 Zacks consensus EPS ($19.63, 11-04 snapshot), about 7-8x EBITDA and a 10%+ FCF yield, with about $0.46B of net debt and $1.8B of buyback authorization left at 6-30. A sustained trade there would mean the market expects earnings to fall, not just growth to slow. Likely causes: a Q4 guide implying flat or negative q/q revenue, visible MAX/Axon share or spread loss to Unity Vector (now growing about 16% q/q), a loss in the Unity dispute that exposes MAX auction data, an Apple/Google platform action, or a damaging litigation development. The agents' mean is $185 (range $180-195); it sits about one 12-month sigma below spot.

supervisor_summary: The five revised forecasts agree closely: median about $300, P(>= $281 on 2027-10-01) about 0.55, agent values $310-348. The stock is about 14x FY27 EPS and about a 6% FCF yield after a 60% de-rating. My checks reversed one round-1 supervisor fact: the CEO's 2026 sales were discretionary, not under a 10b5-1 plan, which adds a little to the class-action risk. They also confirmed that Unity is growing about twice as fast as AppLovin sequentially and that the two are now in litigation over MAX data. Neither moves the centre, so I keep the mean ladder (low confidence) with the research target (12m) at $313 after the citation gate (base round $322) and thesis break $185. The Q3 print and Q4 guide, likely Nov 4, are the next real test.
